**Cover Letter – Junior Product Designer, Monzo**

Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Junior Product Designer position at Monzo. My background as a barista for the past two years has sharpened my ability to listen closely, manage rapid tasks, and create an inviting experience for diverse customers—all core skills that translate into thoughtful, user‑centric design.

I am self‑taught in Figma and have completed multiple projects, including an AI‑powered app that automatically generates personalized workout plans using natural language prompts. This project taught me how to iterate quickly, turn ambiguous user needs into clear wireframes, and collaborate with developers to ship a polished product.

I am passionate about banking technology’s potential to simplify everyday life, and I am eager to bring my fresh perspective, strong visual instincts, and commitment to learning to Monzo’s design team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my skills can contribute to Monzo’s mission.

Sincerely,  
[Your Name]
